name: What factors determine the total cost of a general contracting remodeling project?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the total cost of a general contracting remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: General contracting costs vary widely based on square footage, existing site conditions, structural modifications, and finish material selections. Basic bathroom repairs or cosmetic kitchen refreshes cost significantly less than full gut renovations involving custom tile, marble, and layout alterations. Costs typically break down into labor, framing materials, drywall, paint, fixtures, and licensed trade fees for plumbing and electrical work. Getting an itemized estimate based on clear project goals helps prevent unexpected costs once demolition begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project costs depend on square footage, layout changes, structural framing needs, material choices like custom tile or marble, and required plumbing and electrical work.
